metadata.name: Aluminium Bahrain (Alba)
metadata.benchmark_bond: ALBH $1.25bn ESG Syndicated Loan & Bahrain Industrial Champion
metadata.provenance: financials built 27-Nov-26 from Alba FY24/FY25 Annual Reports & 9M26 Bahrain Bourse Release; quotes await [BBG]

financials_multi_year.source: Alba FY24 Audited Statements (Bahrain Bourse / LSE), read 27-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY24 revenue ~$4.36bn (BHD 1.64bn), net profit $490.8m (BHD 184.5m), net debt/EBITDA 1.17x.

financials_multi_year.source: Alba FY25 Audited Statements (Bahrain Bourse / LSE), read 27-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 revenue ~$4.56bn (BHD 1.72bn), net profit $581.6m (BHD 218.7m, +18.5% YoY), net debt/EBITDA halved to 0.52x via strong FCF and e-Al Hassalah savings.
9M26 net profit surged 44.3% YoY to $422m (BHD 158.7m) despite regional supply chain disruptions and temporary potline curtailments; total assets BHD 2.88bn ($7.66bn).

debt_maturities.source: Alba $1.25bn ESG-linked syndicated facility (net leverage 0.52x FY25).

verdict.stance: Neutral / Low-Cost First-Quartile Smelter (0.52x Net Leverage)
verdict.summary: Alba is the world's largest ex-China single-site aluminium smelter (Line 6, >1.6mtpa) with 9M26 net profit up 44.3% YoY to $422m and net leverage down to 0.52x at FY25. Controlled by Mumtalakat (69.4%) and SABIC (20.6%), credit watch centers on regional energy/alumina logistics and potential Line 7 capex.

positives: First-quartile global cost curve smelter supported by captive gas-fired power and e-Al Hassalah efficiency program.
Deleveraged to 0.52x Net Debt/EBITDA at FY25 with 9M26 net profit up 44.3% YoY to $422m.
Strong sovereign & industrial sponsorship (Bahrain Mumtalakat 69.38%, SABIC 20.62%).
negatives: Bahrain sovereign ceiling linkage (B+ / B2) and domestic natural gas tariff escalation risk.
9M26 operational note highlighted regional supply chain disruptions and temporary reduction line curtailments.
Potential multi-billion Line 7 expansion capex could re-lever balance sheet if approved without equity/partnering.

background.business_overview: World's largest single-site aluminium smelter outside China, located in Bahrain.
background.asset_perimeter: Potlines 1-6 (>1.62m mtpa capacity), captive Power Stations 1-5, calciner & marine terminal.

recent_drivers: 9M26: Net profit $422m (+44.3% YoY) despite temporary potline curtailment & regional logistics friction; assets $7.66bn.
FY25: Net leverage halved from 1.17x to 0.52x on $581.6m net profit.
